name: restaurant-backend
description: Sistema de procesamiento de pedidos para restaurante con arquitectura de microservicios

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix order-service && npm install --prefix kitchen-service && npm install --prefix api-gateway && npm install --prefix notification-service
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix order-service && npm run build --prefix kitchen-service && npm run build --prefix api-gateway && npm run build --prefix notification-service
scripts.start:all: npm start --prefix order-service & npm start --prefix kitchen-service & npm start --prefix api-gateway & npm start --prefix notification-service
scripts.test:all: npm test --prefix order-service && npm test --prefix kitchen-service && npm test --prefix api-gateway
